description: A scenic view of a serene, dense forest with towering trees and scattered sunlight, setting the stage for a mysterious story.
An image of the oldest son nervously encountering a large troll, with the troll menacingly pointing towards the forest.
insertAfter: Da han var kommen bort i Skogen og begyndte at hugge paa en gammel skjægget Gran, kom der et stort digert Trold til ham.

description: The father at home, visibly upset, discussing the cowardice of his sons with them after they return from the troll encounter.
insertAfter: Da han kom hjem igjen, blev Faderen sint, og sagde at aldrig havde Troldene skræmt ham, da han var ung.

description: Askeladden standing triumphantly with a cheese in hand, pretending to squeeze water from it to threaten the troll.
insertAfter: «Tier du ikke still,» skreg han til Troldet, «skal jeg klemme dig, som jeg klemmer Vandet af denne hvide Stenen!»

description: Inside the troll's home, Askeladden cleverly tying his leather pouch around his waist under the table as he eats.
insertAfter: men Gutten tog uformærkt Skindskræppen og knyttede foran sig, og saa øste han mer i Skræppen end han aad selv.

description: Askeladden leaving the troll's home with bags of gold and silver, looking satisfied and relieved.
insertAfter: men Gutten tog alt det Sølv og Guld som fandtes i Berget, og gik hjem med.
